prompt: Write a Solr fl parameter that returns each result doc plus its child documents (max 5) where children match color_s=red. Parent filter is type_s:product. Just the fl line.

Write a Solr fl + subquery params: for each parent result, fetch up to 3 SKUs sorted by price_f asc. SKUs are separate docs with parent_id_s pointing back. Use [subquery] named 'cheapest_skus'. Show fl and all cheapest_skus.* params.
notes: $row.field substitutes per-parent value into subquery; sort + rows give bounded sorted result

prompt: I have a block-join index. For 20 parent results I want top-5 cheapest in-stock children per parent. Why is [subquery] usually faster than [child] for this case? Three reasons in two-three sentences.
notes: filterCache hits, native sort, bounded rows — three [subquery] advantages over [child]

prompt: When using [subquery] to fetch related docs across many parents, the same fq (e.g., in_stock_b:true) appears in every subquery. Will Solr cache it? One sentence + which cache.
notes: Subquery fq goes through standard filterCache; same fq across subqueries reuses entry

prompt: Can the [child] doc transformer sort children by a child field? One short sentence.
notes: [child] returns in segment/insertion order; for sort use [subquery]

prompt: I want to use $row.brand_id_s in a [subquery] but get errors. The brand_id_s field is indexed=true stored=false (not in docValues). Why is this failing and what are the two ways to fix it? Two sentences.
notes: $row needs the field retrievable: either stored=true, in docValues, or in main fl

prompt: My main query uses defType=edismax. I add a [subquery] with sub_results.q='red shoes' but it parses as lucene, not edismax. Why? Show the fix.

must_match_regex: defType.*not inherit|doesn'?t inherit|not inherited|inherit.*not|not pass|not propagat

notes: Subquery does not inherit defType; set sub_results.defType=edismax explicitly

prompt: Children live in a SEPARATE Solr core (not block-join). Which transformer can I use to fetch them per parent — [child] or [subquery]? One word.
I want explain output for each result doc but not the full debug=true overhead. Use a doc transformer. Show the fl line.
notes: [explain] transformer adds per-doc explain in fl without full debug=true

prompt: In SolrCloud, I want to know which shard each result doc came from for debugging. Use a transformer in fl. One line.
notes: [shard] transformer adds shard URL per doc, useful for routing debugging

prompt: For each parent product, fetch up to 5 in-stock SKUs as in_stock and up to 5 out-of-stock SKUs as out_of_stock — both subqueries on parent_id_s. Show fl plus relevant in_stock.* and out_of_stock.* params.
notes: Same factory twice with different result names; per-name parameter scope
